mentions.h: NOVEMBER 13th 1976 - ENFIELD - ENFIELD OPEN '7' ~ Belgrave win at Enfield
mentions.note: printed in quotes as a nickname; 'our New Zealander', battled with Lightman and Marlow early then dropped back to 7th; probably G. Seatter (7th in the result)

share.d: Seatts in The Belgravian, the Belgrave Harriers club gazette, 1977: 1 mention in 1 issue and 1 race result.
